column6: The back-translation alters the phrasing of 'extra marital affair' to 'relationship outside of marriage,' which may soften the moral implication. Additionally, 'needlessly stubborn and resentful' is changed to 'stubborn and resentful without cause,' which could imply a justification for such behavior, thus affecting the doctrinal interpretation of the original text.
column7: Dead works are any works that in review and consideration are not bringing the abundant life that Jesus promised. Having an extra marital affair is very strong poison, it's likely to have a full and negative effect quite soon. Being a needlessly stubborn and resentful person will slowly poison a person until they’ve driven everyone away from them.
column8: Dead works are anything that، upon review and reflection، do not bring the abundant life that Jesus promised. Having a relationship outside of marriage is a very strong toxin، and will most likely very soon have a fully negative effect. Being stubborn and resentful without cause gradually poisons a person until they have driven everyone away.
